author: musho7-dev
subject: Add web dashboard: cars, maps and per-push history with before/after pictures
body:
- tools/export_dashboard.gd renders every car and map with the game's own
  drawing code (animation clock frozen so pictures are deterministic) and
  exports their stats, trait bonuses, upgrade costs and hill profiles
- tools/dashboard.py snapshots any commit, builds a change summary per
  commit, serves the dashboard and installs a background pre-push hook
- dashboard/: Cars tab with search/sort/filter and a details modal,
  Maps tab with hill profiles, History tab grouped by push with
  before/after images, stat diffs and hill-line comparisons
- Generated data lives in the main checkout's dashboard/data (git-ignored)
